# Sakura Player v1.2.0

## 简体中文

v1.2.0 是 Sakura Player 的首个正式版。本说明列出相对 **v1.2.0-beta.4** 的变化，重点是将「算法智能对齐」完整重写为原生 Rust，移除 Python 依赖。

### 原生 Rust 智能对齐

- **无需 Python 环境**：翻译语义对齐、日语读音匹配和中文拼音匹配全部由播放器自带的 Rust 工作进程完成，无需安装 Python、PyTorch 或额外推理运行环境
- **保留现有流程与效果**：支持翻译、音译、重新对齐、逐行预览和勾选应用，沿用主歌词时间轴与原有保存流程；应用结果后仍需显式保存歌词
- **本机离线运行**：音译开箱即用；翻译首次使用时下载或校验模型，准备完成后离线对齐，无需模型 API Key，不上传歌词或音频
- **资源及时释放**：每次任务独占进程，完成或取消后回收模型、词典和计算线程；计算期间保留播放控制响应

### 性能与回归验证

在 Windows x64、AMD Ryzen 9 8940HX 上，使用相同模型、相同输入和 2 个 CPU 推理线程，各启动三次独立进程取中位数，对比重写前后的完整流程：

| 任务      | 重写前耗时 | Rust 耗时 | 重写前峰值内存 | Rust 峰值内存 |
| --------- | ---------- | --------- | -------------- | ------------- |
| 28 行翻译 | 30.214 秒  | 3.982 秒  | 868.0 MiB      | 619.8 MiB     |
| 71 行音译 | 0.956 秒   | 0.253 秒  | 481.9 MiB      | 42.6 MiB      |

本机翻译样本约快 **7.6 倍**，音译样本约快 **3.8 倍**；数据包含进程启动与资源加载，实际耗时随硬件和歌词内容变化。

- 221 组兼容用例通过，固定模型的 28 行翻译结果与重写前一致
- 检查 240 首真实音乐，114 首满足对齐条件，共 4,232 行执行重对齐，无运行异常；其余 120 首缺少必要输入，6 首无歌词
- 90 首歌曲的 3,492 个音译输入行逐行对照，最终文本切片和原词范围零差异
- 全部 240 首原文件的 SHA-256、大小和修改时间一致，批量验证未改写原音乐

### 其他修复与改进

- 完善逐字翻译和音译的原词范围标记、完整性判断，以及辅助轨道的应用和保存重读兼容；LRC 的 Sakura 扩展标签可保留逐字译文与跨词音译范围
- 修复 MCP 客户端保持 HTTP 连接时导致播放器退出延迟的问题
- 同步中英文 README 和文档站，补充原生对齐、模型管理及验证说明

### 下载与使用

提供 Windows、macOS、Linux 的 x64 与 ARM64 构建，请选择对应系统、架构和安装形式。本次实际运行与性能验证平台为 Windows x64。

使用说明见[算法智能对齐](https://sakura-player.pyabunny.com/lyric-alignment.html)与[验证数据](https://sakura-player.pyabunny.com/native.html#对齐验证)，完整变更见[版本比较](https://github.com/Sakura520222/Sakura-Player/compare/v1.2.0-beta.4...v1.2.0)。

## English

v1.2.0 is Sakura Player's first stable release. These notes cover changes since **v1.2.0-beta.4**, led by a complete rewrite of algorithmic lyric alignment in native Rust with Python dependencies removed.

### Native Rust lyric alignment

- **No Python environment:** Translation semantics, Japanese reading matches, and Chinese pinyin matches run entirely in the bundled Rust worker, without installing Python, PyTorch, or an additional inference runtime
- **Preserved workflow and results:** Translation, romanization, realignment, per-line previews, and selective application retain the original lyric timeline and saving workflow; explicitly save lyrics after applying results
- **Offline processing:** Romanization works immediately; translation runs offline after downloading or verifying the model once, without a model API key or uploading lyrics or audio
- **Resource cleanup:** Each task runs in its own process and releases the model, dictionaries, and threads when completed or cancelled, while playback controls remain responsive

### Performance and regression checks

The measurements below compare complete workflows before and after the rewrite on Windows x64 with an AMD Ryzen 9 8940HX. Both use the same model, inputs, and two CPU inference threads. Each workload ran in three fresh processes; values are medians.

| Task                 | Time before rewrite | Rust time | Peak memory before rewrite | Rust peak memory |
| -------------------- | ------------------- | --------- | -------------------------- | ---------------- |
| 28 translation rows  | 30.214 s            | 3.982 s   | 868.0 MiB                  | 619.8 MiB        |
| 71 romanization rows | 0.956 s             | 0.253 s   | 481.9 MiB                  | 42.6 MiB         |

Translation was about **7.6 times faster** and romanization about **3.8 times faster** in these samples. Measurements include process startup and resource loading; actual time depends on hardware and lyric content.

- All 221 compatibility cases passed; the pinned model's 28 translation outputs matched the implementation before the rewrite
- All 240 music files were inspected; 114 eligible tracks with 4,232 rows were realigned without execution errors, while 120 lacked required input and 6 had no lyrics
- Comparing 3,492 romanization input rows across 90 tracks found no differences in final text slices or original word ranges
- SHA-256, size, and modification time matched for all 240 original files; batch validation did not rewrite the music

### Other fixes and improvements

- Improve original-word range metadata, completeness checks, and apply/save/reload compatibility for timed translation and romanization; Sakura extension tags in LRC preserve timed translation and cross-word romanization ranges
- Fix delayed player shutdown when MCP clients keep HTTP connections open
- Update both README languages and the documentation site with native alignment, model management, and validation details

### Downloads and usage

Builds cover Windows, macOS, and Linux on x64 and ARM64. Choose the package matching your system, architecture, and installation type. Runtime and performance validation for this change used Windows x64.

See [Algorithmic lyric alignment](https://sakura-player.pyabunny.com/en/lyric-alignment.html), [Validation data](https://sakura-player.pyabunny.com/en/native.html#alignment-validation), and the [full comparison](https://github.com/Sakura520222/Sakura-Player/compare/v1.2.0-beta.4...v1.2.0).
